title: Remittance Calendar and Payee Reporting — Benefit Withholding and Deduction Orders
content:
Amounts withheld under Benefit Withholding and Deduction Orders are remitted kind by kind to a named payee agency, on a set remittance schedule, by a set number of business days after each remittance period ends, and with a set report. Those terms, with what the report must list and how the payee agency reports a remaining balance, stand as follows for all six kinds.

## Calendar

| Kind | Payee agency | Remittance schedule | Remitted no later than this many business days after the end of the remittance period | Report filed with the remittance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Voluntary Federal Income Tax Withholding | Internal Revenue Service (IRS) | Semiweekly deposit | 3 | Form 945, deposited through EFTPS |
| Voluntary State Income Tax Withholding | Lakeland Department of Revenue | Monthly | 15 | State withholding return |
| Child Support Withholding — Current Support Order | State Disbursement Unit | Per payment batch | 7 | State Disbursement Unit remittance file |
| Child Support Withholding — Arrears-Only Order | State Disbursement Unit | Per payment batch | 7 | State Disbursement Unit remittance file |
| SNAP Overissuance Recovery — Household or Agency Error | SNAP agency | Monthly | 10 | SNAP recovery report |
| SNAP Overissuance Recovery — Intentional Program Violation | SNAP agency | Monthly | 10 | SNAP recovery report |

## Report content and balance reporting

| Kind | Remittance report lists payments with skipped deductions | How the payee agency reports the remaining balance of an amount-limited order |
|---|---|---|
| Voluntary Federal Income Tax Withholding | No | Not applicable |
| Voluntary State Income Tax Withholding | No | Not applicable |
| Child Support Withholding — Current Support Order | Yes | Not applicable |
| Child Support Withholding — Arrears-Only Order | Yes | Monthly balance file |
| SNAP Overissuance Recovery — Household or Agency Error | Yes | Monthly balance file |
| SNAP Overissuance Recovery — Intentional Program Violation | Yes | Monthly balance file |

## Calendar notes

- **Deadline.** The figure in the fourth column is the latest business day, counted after the end of the remittance period, by which that period's withholding is remitted. Federal income tax withholding has the shortest deadline (3 business days on a semiweekly deposit schedule); state income tax withholding has the longest (15 business days on a monthly schedule).
- **Payees by kind.** Both child support kinds remit to the State Disbursement Unit per payment batch; both SNAP Overissuance Recovery kinds remit to the SNAP agency monthly.
- **Skipped deductions.** The four agency kinds list payments with skipped deductions in their remittance report; the two voluntary income tax kinds do not.
- **Balance file.** Only the three amount-limited kinds — Child Support Withholding — Arrears-Only Order and both SNAP Overissuance Recovery kinds — have their remaining balance reported by the payee agency, in a monthly balance file.

## Hypothetical reading

For a hypothetical monthly remittance period of Voluntary State Income Tax Withholding, the period's withholding is remitted to the Lakeland Department of Revenue with the state withholding return no later than the 15th business day after the month ends. For the same month under SNAP Overissuance Recovery — Household or Agency Error, the remittance goes to the SNAP agency with the SNAP recovery report no later than the 10th business day after the month ends.
